book.title: WAI PII EPE MAKEME PEPA PIAMO DOKO

content: Akali Mendenya Imambu Koo Watao Pyakamaiyamo Doko
Dokopa endaki pete omotena, Gadara tange dupanya yuu dokonya Jisasa baanya disaipolo dupa-pipa peami.
Pao pyakamatala, Jisasa baa sipi doko yakinalu piamopa, akali imambu koo paleta mende endakali malu katenge dupanya paliu ipao baa kandanyia.
Akali doko endakali malu katenge dupanya palenge. Endakali mendeme sene kendepi mendeme baa anjala naeyapenge.

Paa longosa baa sene kendepi, anengapupi dupame anjeta pilyaminopa, baame sene kende dupa minao pindanya nepatala, anengapu dupa pindao yakane-yakane pingi. Dopa pilyamopa, endakali mendeme kapa pao baa minao lambapenge nanjingi.
Kuka kotakapi, koteaka lao baa yuu mandapi, endakali malupi dupanya ae latae katao, baanya yonge doko tange kaname konjeta pingi.
Jisasa kuki londatili joo kateamopa, akali dokome kandatala, alo pyao ipupala, baa katea dosa luma lakea.
Luma lakeamopa Jisasame imambu koo doko lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Imambu koo, embame akali dake yakinatala puu”

content: lea. Dopa leamopa baame puu lao, lao pituu, “Gote Etete Ketae Katenge dokonya Ikiningi Jisasa, embame namba aipa piti? Namba tanda andake nanditoo lao Gotenya kenge dokonya embame kyeto joo laa” lea.
Dopa leamopa Jisasame baa tipa pyoo,
lea. Dopa leamopa akali dokome yanu pyao, “Naima imambu koo longo kalyamano. Tenge dokonya, nambanya kenge doko Amii Longo lengena” lea.
Dokopa imambu koo baa-kisa palea dupa yuu doko yakinatala pena laa naena lao akali dokome Jisasa kyeto joo tee lea.
Yuu dokonya manda kilikili mendenya mena kambu andake mende imu nao kateami.
Dokopa imambu koo dupa pitakame Jisasa kyeto joo tee lao, “Naima mena dupa-kisa kolandamana, landa pyalapa lapoko” leami.

Dopa lalu piaminopa, Jisasame dokaita mena dupa-kisa landa pina lea. Dokopa imambu koo dupame akali doko yakinatala, mena dupa-kisa landa piami. Landa pyateaminopa, mena kambu doko papatale mendenya-kaita lanao alo pyao pupala, endaki pete dokonya mangatala kumiami. (Mena kumiami dupa, tausene lapomapi mende.)
Dokopa mena setao kateami dupa siti dokonyapi, yuu yakanepi, dupanya paka pupala, pia doko endakali dupa lamaiyami. Lamaitiaminopa endakali dupame piamo doko kanja epeami.
Dupa Jisasa katea dokonya ipupala kandeaminopa, Amii longo lenge imambu koo doko palenge akali doko indupa yonge pee petala, mona paliu peteamo kandatala paka kaeyami.
Pia doko wambao lengeme kandeami endakali dupame imambu koo palea akali dokopi, menapi dupa-kisa pia dupa dopa pyomona lao lamaiyami.
Lamaitiaminopa yuu tange dupame Jisasa baa dokaitanya yuu doko yakinatala pena lao tee pyao kyeto joo leami.
Dokopa, Jisasa baa sipi dokonya pyakalyiamopa, imambu koo palea akali dokome baa Jisasa-pipa katambana buape lao kyeto joo tee lea.
Dopa leamopa Jisasame daa latala baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Emba andaka pupala, Kamongome emba kondo kaeyapala, embanya pyakalamo dupa emba tata dupa lamaipi”

content: lea.
Dopa lamaitiamopa akali doko pupala, Jisasame baanya pyakamaiya dupa yuu Dekapolisa dokonya tee pyao lao paneamopa, endakali dupa pitaka walu leami.
Jairusa Wanenge Sakatasiamo Doko
Jisasa baa sipi dokonya, endaki pete dokonya yangitena pilyetala, endaki lemba dokonya kateamopa, endakali longo mendapu ipao kambu piami.
Dokopa lotuu anda isingi akali dupanya mende, Jairusa lenge doko epea. Ipao Jisasa kandatala, baanya moko katea dosa tombauli sepala
kyeto joo tee lao, “Nambanya wanenge koo doko kumalanya pilyamona, embame baa-kisa kingi setateno doko, baanya yaina doko etapatamopa baa lenge talapomona, kingi setala ipupoko” lea.
Dokopa Jisasa baa-pipa peambinopa, endakali kambu andake mende baa watao pupala, katao tambukiniami.
Dokopa enda mende yuu gii dii lao andaka nao paliu, ee kana 12 pitaka petenge doko kambu dokonya katea.
Enda dokome dokosa longo-kisa baanya muni sia dupa pitaka nepeaka doko, baanya yaina doko etala naeyamopa, baa tanda longo nao petea.

Jisasame pilyamo lapae dupa enda dokome sepala, Jisasanya yonge peenya iki watandatopa, baanya yaina doko etalapomona lao masia. Dopa lao masetala, endakali kambu dokonya-kaita Jisasanya maita-kaita ipupala, Jisasanya yonge pee punanya kingimi watandea.
Watandalu piamopa baanya yaina doko etea. Dokopa enda dokome baanya yaina doko etalumu lao baanya yonge dokome sia.
Sulu piamopa, Jisasame baanya kyeto mendatupa puumu lao sepala, endakali kambu kateami dotena kapilyetala lao pituu,
lea.
Dopa leamopa baanya disaipolo dupame baa lamaiyoo, “Endakali kambu dakeme emba katao tambukinilyamino kandelyeno doko, aipuma embame,
lelyepe?” leami.
Dopa leaminopa, apimi pyaape lao kanjanya, Jisasame kandayoko lea.
Dopa piamopa, enda dokome baa-kisa pia doko masetala, paka kaeyao walu lao ipao, Jisasa katea dosa tombauli sepala, baa-kisa pia dupa pitaka lao panao kiningi pii doko Jisasa lamaiya.
Dokopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Wanenge, embame namba tungi pyapi dokome, embanya yaina doko etelyamona, emba yaina etapae doko mona yaepatala puu”

content: lea.

Dopa lao kateamopa, lotuu anda isingi Jairusanya andaka katenge akali mendapu ipupala Jairusa lamaiyoo, “Embanya wanenge doko kumatalamona, aipuma embame Mana Lenge doko kenda pisoo epena lelyepe” leami.
Dopa leaminopa Jisasame pii doko sulu petala, lotuu anda isingi akali doko lamaiyoo,
lea.
Dopa latala, endakali waka mende baa watao naepena latala, Pitapi, Jemesapi, Jemesa kaiminingi Jonepi dutupa-pipa iki peami.
Pao lotuu anda isingi akali dokonya andaka pyakamatala Jisasame kandeamopa, endakali dupa yako lao ee laa-laa peami.
Dokopa Jisasa andaka kolandatala dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Aipuma nyakama yako lao ee laa-laa pelyami? Wanaku doko kumala naeyalamo. Baa luu palelyamona”

content: lea.

Dopa leamopa, endakali dupame baa lamba lao gii kaeyami. Dokopa baame dokaita watao kamaka pyalyetala, wanaku dokonya endangi dokopi, takange dokopi, disaipolo tepoma apata peami dutupapi, dutupa iki wanaku kumapae sia dokonya lanyoo pea.
Pupala wanaku dokonya kinginya minatala baa lamaiyoo,
lea. (Pii dokonya tenge doko,
Dopa lalu piamopa, wanaku ee kana 12 latae doko sakatatala kaita paeya. Paeyamo doko kandatala, endakali kateami dutupa etete paka kaeyao walu leami.
Pia doko endakali dupame setamina, mende lamaiya naena lao Jisasame kyeto joo dutupa pyalanya lea. Dopa latala wanaku doko nee nena nyoo maina lea.
